messages.subject: empirical plot not displayed
parts:
Hi everyone

I am running a two dimensional model in mirt and I intend to get the empirical plot using the following code:

itemfit(escala_sask_grm_fit5, empirical.plot = 5,)   ##escala_sask_grm_fit5 is my model##

but no chart is produced. I only get a dataframe as this one: 

item 1 sask6i

Am I doing something wrong or is it a bug?

The complete code is this:

#1
escala_sask_grm_fatores5 <- "F1 =  sask3i, sask4i, sask6i, sask8i, sask15i
                            F2 = sask1, sask2, sask7, sask9, sask10, sask11, sask12, sask13, sask14, sask16, sask17, sask18, sask19, sask20"

#2
escala_sask_grm_fit5 <- mirt(data = sask_inv[-5], escala_sask_grm_fatores5, itemtype = "graded", rotate = "oblimin", SE = TRUE)

#3
itemfit(escala_sask_grm_fit5, empirical.plot = 5,)

Thank you all

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: empirical plot not displayed
parts:
The empirical.plot option only applies to unidimensional models. I'm somewhat surprised a warning wasn't thrown...

Phil
